scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Ex-Servicemen of and above the Age of 60 Years and their Widows
other_conditions: Applicant must be an ex‑serviceman of other ranks (Havildar and below) or the widow of such an ex‑serviceman.
Applicant must not be receiving any pension, financial assistance, or maintenance allowance from any government department or organization.
Applicants discharged on the ground of "Service No Longer Required" due to misconduct or inefficiency are ineligible, as are their widows.
Beneficiaries must submit survival verification proof each year in the month of April.
If a beneficiary later receives any pension or other financial assistance, they will be permanently debarred from all welfare schemes of the Rajya Zila Sainik Boards in Haryana.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month (with an annual increase of ₹400) is provided to eligible ex‑servicemen and widows aged 60 years and above.
documents_required: Domicile certificate issued by the competent authority authorized by the Haryana Government
Attested copy of the Ration Card
